subject: Mutual Action Plan — final mile: SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA logistics & retention ceilings
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@greenline.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & go/no-go window — SOC 2/CAIQ/DPA questions

Team — attaching our latest MAP draft (MAP_Greenline_v3.xlsx). We're trying to lock the close window for the contract and need clarity on three items to confirm final procurement dates: 

1) SOC 2 evidence timeline — can Redwood provide the specific artifact owners and dates you expect to deliver (e.g., control-owner evidence, SOC 2 report availability)?
2) SIG/CAIQ responses — will you accept a completed CAIQ spreadsheet or do you need an additional narrative for any high-risk controls?
3) DPA & retention ceilings — Greenline needs an explicit data retention policy clause (max retention for customer data and logs) and confirmation of deletion support for EU-residency customer subsets.

We have legal availability the week of 6/28 for final sign, so if we can close these threads by EOD 6/29 we should be on track.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Integrations, Greenline Financial
Attachments: MAP_Greenline_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & go/no-go window — SOC 2/CAIQ/DPA questions

Tom — thanks for the MAP and the clear deadlines. Quick answers / actions from our side: 

- SOC 2 evidence: we can commit to delivering the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a control evidence pack. Owners: security@redwood.ai (SOC2 report) and infra-compliance@redwood.ai (operational evidence). ETA: SOC 2 report available immediately (we completed in Q1 2027); control evidence pack can be compiled by 6/25 and uploaded to the shared drive.

- CAIQ/SIG: we prefer the CAIQ spreadsheet as the canonical artifact. For any items flagged as "high" (e.g., key management, encryption at rest in certain private deployments) we'll add brief narrative notes inline. We'll attach CAIQ_responses_Q2_2027.xlsx by 6/23.

- DPA & retention: we can accept a single DPA with a retention appendix. Proposed retention ceilings: customer PII retention default 90 days after project termination; logs retention configurable up to 365 days with opt-in for extended retention. For EU-residency accounts we support data residency + deletion APIs; we'll attach a DPA_redline_v1.pdf with the specific clauses suggested. Legal will need to review.

Open questions for Greenline to confirm: 
- Do you require subprocessor disclosure prior to signature or can that be part of a quarterly notice?
- Are there any industry-specific controls you need beyond SOC 2/SIG (e.g., PCI scope carveouts)?

I'll loop in Kimberly to confirm contract/legal redlines. If we can align on retention ceilings by 6/24, we'll be positioned for your 6/28 legal slot.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & go/no-go window — SOC 2/CAIQ/DPA questions

Tom / Team — adding legal context and a couple of contract asks from our side so your procurement has full visibility. 

1) DPA redline: attached is DPA_redline_v1.pdf with our standard language. Two negotiable items we typically see: retention maximums (we can accept your 90/365 proposal with an explicit change-control clause), and escrow/escrow-equivalent obligations for keys.
2) Subprocessors: Redwood maintains a subprocessor list and provides 30-day notice for additions; if Greenline requires pre-approval, we'll need that in the DPA (adds time).
3) Liability/indemnity: we'll accept a mutual indemnity limited to direct damages with a cap tied to 12 months of hosted fees. 

Action items for us: I'll do a redline to your procurement's DPA and return by 6/24 EOD. Rishi — please confirm where we should host SOC 2 artifacts for their review (Drive link vs. secure binder).

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA_redline_v1.pdf (annotated PDF, 18KB)

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@greenline.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & go/no-go window — SOC 2/CAIQ/DPA questions

Kimberly / Rishi — quick answers from procurement/legal after an internal sync: 

- Subprocessor pre-approval: Greenline needs visibility but 30-day notice is acceptable for most additions; for any subprocessor with access to raw financial PII, pre-approval will be required. We'll flag that in procurement.
- Retention ceilings: 90/365 looks fine. For EU-regulated customers we require data residency + deletion APIs within 72 hours of a verified request; confirm you can meet deletion SLA for EU-customer datasets.
- SOC 2 artifacts: procurement requests a secure binder (Drive link acceptable if link requires GSuite domain restriction). If you can upload the control evidence pack there by 6/25 we'll share with audit folks.

I'll mark the MAP with a green checkbox for those items pending receipt of the CAIQ and DPA redline. We can target the final procurement review on 6/28 morning.

—Tom

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenline.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@greenline.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — final mile: SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA logistics & retention ceilings

All — thanks for the rapid responses. Final-mile checklist and owners below (we're treating this as the MAP action card):

- SOC 2 report + control evidence pack: Owner: security@redwood.ai (Rishi to coordinate). Due: 2027-06-25. Deliverable: secure Drive binder link.
- CAIQ responses: Owner: rishi_malhotra / compliance team. Due: 2027-06-23. Deliverable: CAIQ_responses_Q2_2027.xlsx attached to MAP.
- DPA redline + retention appendix: Owner: kimberly_park. Due: 2027-06-24. Deliverable: DPA_redline_v1.pdf returned to Greenline legal.
- EU deletion SLA confirmation: Owner: infra-compliance@redwood.ai (cc'd via Rishi). SLA: 72 hours for verified requests; confirm API endpoint and process by 6/24.
- Subprocessor notice process: Owner: contracts operations (Kim). Confirm 30-day notice except pre-approval for processors with raw PII access.

Next steps: Rishi — once you upload the evidence binder and CAIQ we'll push to Greenline legal. Kimberly — please send the DPA redline by EOD 6/24 so they can run procurement review 6/28. Tom — please confirm if procurement needs a separate SSO account to access the binder or domain-restricted Drive link is sufficient.

If all items are green by 6/24–6/25, we keep the 6/28 contract slot. If any material open legal items remain after 6/28 we'll trigger the escalation path in the MAP (exec sign-off and extended review window).

Thanks — short sync if needed tomorrow at 10am PT.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
summary: Final-mile MAP thread with Greenline Financial focusing on SOC 2 evidence delivery, CAIQ responses, and DPA retention ceilings. Owners and deadlines assigned to meet procurement's 6/28 legal slot.
